claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 uses dimension clusters as anchor boxes to predict bounding boxes.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Following YOLO9000 our system predicts bounding boxes using dimension clusters as anchor boxes [15].

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 predicts an objectness score for each bounding box using logistic regression.
claims.evidence_quote_short: YOLOv3 predicts an objectness score for each bounding box using logistic regression.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 uses independent logistic classifiers for class prediction instead of a softmax.
claims.evidence_quote_short: we do not use a softmax as we have found it is unnecessary for good performance, instead we simply use independent logistic classifiers.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 predicts boxes at three different scales using a feature pyramid network-like approach.
claims.evidence_quote_short: YOLOv3 predicts boxes at 3 different scales. Our system extracts features from those scales using a similar concept to feature pyramid networks [8].

claims.claim_text_normalized: Darknet-53 performs on par with state-of-the-art classifiers but with fewer floating point operations and more speed.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Darknet-53 performs on par with state-of-the-art classifiers but with fewer floating point operations and more speed.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 is much better than SSD variants and comparable to state-of-the-art models on the AP50 metric.
claims.evidence_quote_short: YOLOv3 is much better than SSD variants and comparable to state-of-the-art models on the AP50 metric.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 performance drops significantly as the IOU threshold increases, indicating it struggles to align boxes perfectly with objects.
claims.evidence_quote_short: performance drops significantly as the IOU threshold increases indicating YOLOv3 struggles to get the boxes perfectly aligned with the object.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Using focal loss dropped YOLOv3's mAP by about 2 points.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We tried using focal loss. It dropped our mAP about 2 points.
